lots.guide_summary: Nothing survives: 0 sold, 0 unsold, 0 asking. The researcher found no comps and I could not add any because the web search budget is used up.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence, so both maximums are 0. All-in cost would be hammer x 1.22.
lots.confidence_reason: No comps of any kind. The TONKA tyre mark is readable but the makers of the two gold cars are not. Their function (radio or battery toy) and working order are unknown.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 3: TONKA moulded on the jeep tyres; jeep body scuffed with rust spots and dirt. Photo 2 (enlarged): Rolls-Royce style grille with RR badge, rust on the bonnet side and front guard, bent gilt front bumper. Photo 4: JPS decals, 'Formula 1 Special' and '2' on the nose, and an open side hole showing loose parts inside. Gilt worn on both gold cars.
lots.condition: Well played-with. Rust, worn gilt, a bent bumper on the roadster, dirt throughout. Working order unknown, and battery compartments not shown.

Enlarged carton print: 'M: 38.3 X 26.3 X 20.4CM, G.W. 14.6 KG, N.W. 14.2 KG' on both cartons. At roughly 1.3 to 1.5kg per 344pp royal 8vo hardcover, that suggests about 10 copies per carton, so about 20 in the lot (estimate). One copy is out and open; it looks new. The cartons are opened and taped.
